mentions.name: QuietReads
mentions.description: A single-player book tracking app with an AI assistant, designed for engaging deeply with reading without gamification or social features. Planned and in-progress features include an experimental MCP integration to bring the user's bookshelf into AI assistants, OCR to build notes from screenshots, and voice notes.
mentions.problem: The author got tired of the gamification and social elements of Goodreads, StoryGraph and others, and cares about engaging deeply with what they are reading rather than reviews.
mentions.audience: Got tired of the gamification and social elements of Goodreads, StoryGraph and others. I don't care too much about reviews, but do care about engaging deeply with what I am reading.
